newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwoon Chung gets 10 new coaches.
newsitem.headline: Kwoon Chung gets 10 new coaches.

text.p: Kwoon Chung Bus Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had taken delivery of a third of 30 tour coaches ordered from Mitsubishi Motors Corp, adding that its fleet would soon exceed 1,000 buses.

The bus services operator said the first batch of 10 MM828 41-seat luxury coaches was delivered in December and 20 more would arrive in the next two months. It gave no details of its investment in the coaches.
"The recent move into the tour coach service business is one of Kwoon Chung's business expansion plans for 1997," it said.
The fleet would soon exceed 1,000 buses, it said.
Kwoon Chung also said it was involved in three bus service ventures in China.

The venture in Harbin in northeastern Heilongjiang province was officially opened on January 9 with 30 buses, it said. Another venture in Jieyang in Guangdong province was opened on January 27 with 20 buses.
The company said it started a joint venture in Dalian in the northeastern province of Liaoning last year.
The Hong Kong-based bus line operator was listed in Hong Kong in September 1996.
It said it would use the HK$93 million in net proceeds after expenses to fund expansion of its fleet and related bus services businesses in Hong Kong and China.
Kwoon Chung shares ended Tuesday HK$0.025 down at HK$2.625.
